description: Bike Rack Use By Stop By Fiscal Week is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by ACT Government Open Data. Provides the number of bike rack uses by passengers broken down by stop and fiscal week from 9 May 2016 to 23 July 2017 (inclusive). Bike rack uses are recorded each time a bike is placed on a bike rack by pushing a button on the MyWay ticketing system on scheduled services. Coverage: Canberra. The portal files it under the publisher ACT Government Open Data. Its tags are bike, bike-rack, bus, stop, transport. It offers 6 resource(s) in csv, geojson, json, kml, kmz. The portal shows 2026-09-27 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
